name: Multi-pass Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting Pipeline with Hole Filling
definition: A multi-pass rendering pipeline that projects rays to screen space, performs coarse/fine raycasting, detects unfilled pixels (holes), and iteratively fills them using a hole buffer and ID tracking system.
summary: This multi-pass OpenCL pipeline renders sparse voxel octrees by separating initial raycasting from iterative hole detection and filling, ensuring visual completeness in sparse regions.
